review_evidence: README documents formal definitions, equivalences, closure properties, strict inclusions, and decidability results across the Chomsky hierarchy and related automata/grammar models.
Inspected src/Langlib/Classes/ContextFree/Definition.lean: it defines grammar_context_free, is_CF, is_CF_via_cfg, and CF; the repository contains hundreds of corresponding theorem modules.

Inspected src/Langlib/Automata.lean and confirmed it is an auto-generated import hub; the filtering contract currently requires import-only navigation modules to remain primary until auxiliary search is live, so no hard exclusion is applied.
summary: Retain Langlib, a substantial Lean formal-language theory library; generated import hubs remain retained under the current auxiliary-search gate.

review_evidence: Declaration grep over all 448 files (theorem/lemma/def/structure/class/instance/inductive/abbrev/example/axiom/opaque/notation/syntax/macro/elab, with public/private/meta/noncomputable prefixes) found 9334 declaration lines; 445 files have at least one.

src/Langlib/Classes.lean (17066 bytes, 259 public imports) and src/Langlib/Grammars.lean (12781 bytes, 177 public imports) are auto-generated import hubs with `@[expose] public section` and a module docstring; they are retained under FILTER-007 because no deployed auxiliary channel was verified.

lakefile.lean (702 bytes, read in full) is Lake build configuration requiring mathlib v4.33.0 and declaring lean_libs Langlib, LanglibTest, Challenge, Solution; it is retained as the unit's default disposition since it is tiny and the evidence bar for hard exclusion is not argued here.

Challenge.lean (47739 bytes) is a Mathlib-only statement surface for the extended Chomsky hierarchy (grammar classes, automata presentations, strict inclusions); Solution.lean (2274 bytes) restates theorems such as RG_strict_subclass_Linear_of_card in namespace ChomskyHierarchy.

Smallest source file src/Langlib/Examples/EmptyWord.lean (297 bytes, read in full) defines `public def emptyWordLanguage`; src/Langlib/Classes/ContextFree/Definition.lean (911 bytes, read) defines grammar_context_free, is_CF, is_CF_via_cfg, CF.

Largest file src/Langlib/Grammars/NonContracting/Equivalence/ContextSensitive.lean is 339589 bytes of proof development; test/LanglibTest demos (2702, 7430, 29752 bytes) contain 2, 4, 9 example/theorem/def lines respectively.
summary: Surveyed all 448 listed files of nielstron__langlib (Lean 4 module-system formal-language theory library): 440 under src/Langlib (Automata 90, Classes 193+hub, Grammars 136+hub, Examples 13, Utilities 8), 3 test demos, Challenge.lean, Solution.lean, lakefile.lean.
